subject: OrbitLabs marketplace credit terms & activation
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@orbitlabs.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Kim <anna@orbitlabs.io>
Date: 2028-03-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot credit request for OrbitLabs x Redwood marketplace listing

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had a productive internal sync and would like to move forward with a co-marketed pilot on Redwood's marketplace. OrbitLabs is proposing a 60-day pilot for a single SMB customer. For the trial we need a marketplace promo credit (voucher) to cover usage up to $30,000. Objectives:
- Validate integration flows (SSO, billing metering)
- Measure end-to-end latency and token spend on a 1M-token workload
- Capture usage analytics for a joint case study

Can you confirm Redwood's eligibility checklist and what paperwork you need from OrbitLabs to get a voucher issued? We can sign a short voucher agreement and provide a PO if that's required. Timeline: would like credits issued and activated by 2028-03-28 to sync with our launch window.

Attaching a short pilot scope (sent separately).

Thanks,
Sandeep
Director, Partnerships — OrbitLabs
[Attachment: OrbitLabs_Pilot_Scope.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@orbitlabs.io>
Cc: Anna Kim <anna@orbitlabs.io>
Date: 2028-03-20T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request for OrbitLabs x Redwood marketplace listing

Hi Sandeep — great to hear, excited to get OrbitLabs running. Short answers and next steps below: 

1) Eligibility: yes — marketplace partners running co-sell pilots are eligible for merchant vouchers. We typically issue 60–90 day credits for initial proof-of-value.
2) Amount: suggested $30,000 (matches your ask) — delivery subject to voucher T&Cs and activation window.
3) What we need from you:
   - OrbitLabs Redwood account ID (or confirm you want us to generate a voucher code and let you apply it to the customer checkout)
   - Signed Voucher Agreement (I attached draft "OrbitLabs_Voucher_Agreement_v1.pdf")
   - PO or written confirmation for accounting (if you need us to invoice the non-covered overage)
   - Pilot start date (you asked for 03/28) — we can align.
4) Usage guardrails (important):
   - Max token spend per customer: we recommend a per-account cap of $10k to preserve distribution; total pool $30k
   - Allowed SKUs: hosted inference (text-gen, chat) — embeddings excluded unless pre-approved
   - Voucher expires 60 days after activation if not consumed

If that sounds good I can loop in Lauren (CS) to provision the voucher and Soojin (partner ops) to sign off on co-marketing credits. Is a DocuSign link OK for the agreement?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OrbitLabs_Voucher_Agreement_v1.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-20T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: OrbitLabs voucher approval request — $30k / 60d pilot (DL-ORB-7893)

Lauren / Soojin —

Looping you in for approvals and provisioning. OrbitLabs (Sandeep, Anna) have requested a $30k marketplace voucher to run a 60‑day pilot starting 2028-03-28. Key asks: voucher code creation, per-account caps (10k), and a signed Voucher Agreement. Attachments: draft agreement and a CSV template (voucher_activation_sheet.csv) we'll use for activation.

Quick decisions needed:
- Finance OK with $30k promotional exposure for partner-sourced pilot?
- CS can we create voucher and set per-account caps in billing console?
- Partner ops: confirm co-marketing checkbox for the case study and HubSpot campaign registration (HS-12345).

If you greenlight I'll route the DocuSign and confirm the activation workflow with OrbitLabs. Short replies welcome.

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Sandeep / Ben —

All set from CS/finance side: approved for a $30,000 voucher pool with 60-day activation window and per-account caps of $10,000. Next steps to activate: 

1) Sandeep: please confirm whether OrbitLabs wants a single voucher code for the marketplace listing or three per-customer codes (we can do either). If single code, tell us the target marketplace listing ID and we will attach it there.
2) Sign the voucher agreement: I have created a DocuSign envelope and shared the link below. Please sign and return so we can provision.
3) If you want the voucher applied to a specific customer checkout, share the Redwood account ID and we will tag the voucher.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABCD1234
HubSpot campaign: https://redwood.hubspot.com/record/HS-12345

Attachments: OrbitLabs_Voucher_Agreement_v1.pdf (for signature), voucher_activation_sheet.csv (for internal provisioning).

Ben/So: I will provision the code and add activation caps once the agreement is signed and we've received the PO (optional). If OrbitLabs needs an expedited activation we can provision a provisional code pending PO and reconcile later.

Sandeep — can you confirm preferred voucher cadence and whether OrbitLabs will provide a PO? If yes, please send PO to billing@redwood.ai and cc me.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
